common.serverDown: Awaaz se baat nahi ho pa rahi. Server chalu hone mein ek minute lag sakta hai.
common.couldNotSave: Save nahi ho paaya. Kripya phir se koshish karein.

login.headline: Aise logon ke liye phone call jo sun ya bol nahi sakte.
login.subhead: Aap likhein, Awaaz aapki jagah bolega. Wahan se jo bola jayega woh likha hua dikhega, paise aur time alag se dikhenge.
login.footnote: Awaaz har call ke shuru mein doosre insaan ko bata deta hai ki ek assistant madad kar raha hai.
login.signInHint: Call karne aur uthane ke liye sign in karein.
login.createHint: Bas ek minute lagega. Phir aap chuna sakte hain ki kaise bolna aur sunna hai.
login.devUser: Dev user ki tarah aage badhein (sirf local)
login.accountCreated: Account ban gaya. Mail check karein aur link par click karke confirm karein, phir sign in karein.
login.resetSent: Agar is email se account hai, toh humne password badalne ka link bhej diya hai.
login.typeEmailFirst: Pehle upar apna email likhein, phir "Password bhool gaye" par dabayein.

authErrors.notConfirmed: Pehle apna email confirm karein. Apne inbox mein link check karein.
authErrors.exists: Is email par pehle se account hai. Sign in karne ki koshish karein.
authErrors.shortPassword: Kam se kam 6 aksharon ka password istemal karein.
authErrors.tooMany: Bohot baar koshish ho gayi. Kuch minute ruk kar phir koshish karein.
authErrors.badEmail: Yeh email address sahi nahi lag raha.
authErrors.googleOff: Google sign-in abhi chalu nahi hai.
authErrors.generic: Kuch gadbad ho gayi. Kripya phir se koshish karein.

onboarding.languageHint: Awaaz iska istemal sabhi jagah karega, likhe hue shabdon mein bhi. Aap ise kabhi bhi badal sakte hain.
onboarding.title: Aaiye aapki calls set karein
onboarding.hint: Do chote sawal. Baad mein aap Main (Me) mein sab badal sakte hain.
onboarding.nameHint: Yeh naam har call ke shuru mein doosre insaan ko bataya jata hai.
onboarding.howPhone: Aap phone ka istemal kaise karte hain?
onboarding.fineTuneHint: Koi bhi tarika chuniye. Bolne ka pehla tarika calls par aapka main tarika hoga.

home.title: Calls
home.noCallsBody: Call shuru karein, ya neeche ek practice call karke dekhein ki baatein kaise likhkar aati hain aur jawab kaise jaate hain.
home.newCallHint: Jise call karna hai unka number dalei. Awaaz unhe batayega ki ek assistant madad kar raha hai.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.emptyBody: Jin logon ya dukaan par aap baar-baar call karte hain, unhe save karein. Kuch note bhi likh sakte hain, jaise "meri BP ki dawa Telma 40 hai", aur Awaaz ise jawab mein istemal kar sakta hai.
contacts.sheetHint: Awaaz jawabo ke sujhav mein notes ka istemal kar sakta hai.
contacts.name: Naam
contacts.notesPlaceholder: Jaise: meri BP ki dawa Telma 40 hai
contacts.saveFailed: Save nahi ho paya. Number check karein.
contacts.deleteBody: Isse yeh contact aur iske notes hat jayenge. Puraani calls ka hisab rahega.

me.title: Main
me.nameHint: Har call ke shuru mein doosre insaan ko bataya jata hai.
me.phrasesHint: Call par jaldi bolne ke liye chote vakya
me.signedInAs: {{email}} ke naam se sign in hai

profile.startFromHint: Pehle se bane option sirf aasan karne ke liye hain. Aap neeche sab badal sakte hain.
profile.howTalkHint: Jo jo aap istemal karte hain sab chuniye. Pehla wala aapka main tarika hoga.
profile.howHear: Main unki baat kaise sunta hoon
profile.howHearHint: Aap mila kar chun sakte hain, jaise likhe shabd aur saaf awaaz dono ek saath.
profile.iRead: Baatein is bhasha mein likhi hui aayein
profile.disclosure: Doosre insaan ko batayein ki ek assistant madad kar raha hai
profile.summary: Aap bolte hain: {{talk}}{{also}}. Aap sunte hain: {{hear}}.

presets.deafspeak: Sunaayi nahi deta, par bol sakta hoon
presets.deaftype: Sunaayi nahi deta, likhna pasand hai

voice.title: Aap bolein, Awaaz use sunayega
voice.hint: Main mic mein bolunga. Awaaz use likh dega, main check karunga, aur Awaaz saaf bol kar sunayega.

replies.title: Tay vakya aur aasan jawab
replies.hint: Ek baar dabate hi jawab chala jayega.

help.title: Sahi vakya banane mein madad
help.hint: Kuch shabd likhein, poora saaf sentence ban jayega. Pehle aap dekhein, phir jayega.

captions.title: Saath-saath likha hua (Live captions)
captions.hint: Bade akshar, numbers alag se chamkenge.

clear.title: Mujhe padh kar sunayein
clear.hint: Jo woh bolenge use dheere aur tez awaaz mein padh kar sunaya jayega.

summary.title: Call ke baad ki baatein (Summary)
summary.hint: Kya tay hua, kitne paise ya time tha, jo aap padh ya sun sakte hain.

vibe.title: Vibration se pata chale
vibe.hint: Jab woh bolna shuru aur khatam karenge toh phone vibrate hoga.

translate.title: Mere liye translate karein
translate.hint: Woh chahe koi bhi bhasha bolein, mere liye meri bhasha mein padhein aur likhein.

phrases.title: Mere tayar vakya
phrases.emptyTitle: Abhi koi tayar vakya nahi hai
phrases.emptyBody: Jab tak aap apna vakya nahi jodte, call screen par shuruati vakya dikhenge.

history.nothingSaid: Is call par koi baat nahi hui.
history.summarise: Is call ki mukhya baatein batayein

call.draftTitle: Aapke liye likha gaya. Bolne se pehle dekh lein
call.draftUnclear: Aapke shabd thode ulajh gaye the. Check kar lein ki kya matlab sahi hai.
call.helpPlaceholder: Kuch shabd likhein, main sentence bana dunga
call.phrasesHint: Bolne ke liye ek par dabayein.
call.keypadHint: Phone menu ke liye number dabayein, jaise "1 dabayein…".

blocked.scam_digits: Nahi bheja gaya: Awaaz is call par OTP ya PIN ke number nahi bolega.
blocked.empty: Bhejney ke liye kuch nahi hai.
blocked.too_long: Yeh msg bohot bada hai. Kripya chota karein.

call.micNothing: Kuch sunaayi nahi diya. Phone ke paas aakar phir se koshish karein.
call.micFailed: Aapki awaaz ko shabd mein nahi badal paaye. Phir koshish karein ya likhein.
call.micDenied: Mic ka istemal karne ki permission dein.

otp_request.title: Unhone aapka OTP maanga hai
otp_request.body: Bank kabhi call par OTP nahi maangte. Awaaz is call par OTP ya PIN padh kar nahi sunayega.

pin_request.title: Unhone aapka PIN maanga hai
pin_request.body: Kisi bank ya dukaan ko call par aapke PIN ki zaroorat nahi hoti. Awaaz is call par PIN ya code padh kar nahi sunayega.

upi_pin.title: Unhone aapka UPI PIN maanga hai
upi_pin.body: Aapka UPI PIN sirf aapke liye hai. Awaaz is call par PIN ya code padh kar nahi sunayega.

cvv_request.title: Unhone aapke card ka CVV maanga hai
cvv_request.body: Call par CVV kabhi mat batayein. Awaaz is call par card ke baare mein nahi bolega.

remote_app.title: Unhone koi app install karne ko kaha hai
remote_app.body: Phone par kehne par koi bhi app install mat karein. Isse woh aapka phone aur bank dekh sakte hain.

other.title: Yeh nakli (scam) call ho sakti hai
other.body: Saavdhan rahein. Awaaz is call par OTP, PIN ya card ki jankari nahi bolega.

errors.draft_failed: Main yeh nahi bana paaya. Kuch aur shabd likhkar try karein.
errors.not_available: Bolne mein madad ke liye live AI service chahiye.
errors.unknown_preview: Ab check karne ke liye kuch nahi hai.
errors.not_implemented: Yeh feature abhi chalu nahi hai.
errors.bad_event: Kuch gadbad ho gayi. Phir se koshish karein.
